data.name: Great Town Business: Life, Living & Luxuries
data.detailed_description:
From Rags to Riches, and Betrayal to Billions.

You were at the top of the world, until your trusted co-founder and best friend stabbed you in the back, stripping away your wealth, your company, and your status. Left with absolutely nothing, it is time to start from scratch, build a financial empire, and take back everything that was stolen from you.

You aren’t just broke; you are homeless. After the ultimate betrayal, you wake up in a tiny, rundown motel room with nothing but a bed and a dream of revenge. Every penny you make at the cash register counts toward escaping this room, renting your first real apartment, and eventually building the grandest mansions in Simora Town.

Key Features

Wishlist Today to Reclaim Your Empire!

  • Life, Love, and Sweet Revenge: Customize your character completely from head to toe. Interact with a living city of unique NPCs, build deep friendships, find romance, and follow a gripping narrative of ultimate corporate betrayal.

  • The Ultimate Underdog Grind: Start as a solo cashier ringing up customers, bagging groceries, and stocking shelves by hand. Feel the thrill of turning your very first hard-earned pennies into a sprawling retail empire.

  • Micro-Manage to Millions: Don't just watch charts, get your hands dirty! Order inventory, physically design your store layouts, set competitive prices, and optimize your fast-food kitchen to survive the dinner rush.

  • Hire Your Way to the Top: Transition from stressed shopkeeper to brilliant CEO. Recruit, and manage a reliable workforce of cashiers and stockers so you can focus on buying up real estate across the city.

  • Build Your Ultimate Flex: Spend your hard-earned millions on the good life. Buy empty plots to design massive custom mansions from scratch, or purchase existing properties and remodel every single room to your exact taste.

  • Drive, Flip, and Explore: Cruise through a vibrant third-person open world in a fleet of cars. Buy vehicles, tune them up, drive them around the city, or flip them for a quick profit.

data.short_description: Conquer the ultimate 3D sandbox life! Run a thriving supermarket, restaurant, and furniture empire with deep micro-management. Drive cars, build your dream home, and flirt with NPCs in a living town where every item is interactive and neighbors actually visit you. From cashier to tycoon!

content_descriptors.notes: This game features adult relationship mechanics, including dating, romance, and intimacy with NPCs. All sexual or intimate acts occur strictly off-screen and are never visually depicted. Intimacy between consenting adult characters is represented solely through abstract, playful visual cues such as a moving bed, closed curtains, or humorous cartoon animations with characters remaining fully clothed before and after the interaction. The game contains absolutely no explicit nudity, graphic sexual depictions, non-consensual acts, violence, substance abuse, or self-harm.
